feeds.title: Rottweiler Club of Canada
feeds.description: Rottweiler Club of Canada is a non-profit organization dedicated to promoting responsible breeding and ownership. Learn more about the Rottweiler and keep current on Rottweiler related events in Canada, events, awards, breeders, litters and more.

feeds.title: Rottweiler Life
feeds.description: Rottweiler Life is your first and last stop when it comes to quality Rottweiler information. Training, Puppies, Breeders, Rescue - we have you covered! This page is to help many rottweiler owners to deal with the amazing breed rottweiler, give them tips, articles, and answers to all their questions.

feeds.title: Living with Rottweilers
feeds.description: Welcome to Living with Rottweilers by Nelson Abdullah. This blog is not about me, it is about the Rottweilers who stole my heart and have filled my life with their love. Subscribe to our stories, told on the lighter side but with all the joy and the sorrow we experience, with lots of photos.

feeds.title: Total Rottweiler Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Total Rottweiler Magazine is an international Rottweiler Magazine with a worldwide circulation. Our focus is to be a resource tool that readers can utilize for work, show, and information on the breed.

feeds.title: DKV Rottweilers Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to DKV Rottweilers Blog. We feature all about Rottweilers, German Rottweilers, Rottweiler puppies, training, tips and more!

feeds.title: A Love Of Rottweilers
feeds.description: The ultimate online Rottweiler owners resource. Whether you're a life-long Rottie lover looking to share info & photos with other like-minded people; a first-time Rottweiler owner with an adorable puppy in your arms; or anything else in between, you'll find lots to see on this site.

feeds.title: Not A Bully » Rottweilers
feeds.description: This section of the NotABully.org Blog covers everything you need to know about Rottweilers. Author Logan started NotABully.org to provide positive education around bully breed dogs.
